Lanterns: Here's Why The Series Downplays The Green Lantern Corps | Comic Con 2026
It's fair to say that Nathan Fillion's Guy Gardner may not be the greatest ambassador for the rest of Green Lanterns. Showrunner Chris Mundy and the cast of Lanterns - Kyle Chandler, Aaron Pierre, Garret Dillahunt, and Poorna Jagannathan - joined IGN at SDCC 2026 to explain why a murder investigation in the Midwest was the perfect way to more fully introduce the interplanetary protectors of the DCU. The cast also test their mettle in a quiz: "Green Lantern or Metal Band?"

text:
Batman: Caped Crusader - Chronicles: Official Announcement Trailer | Comic Con 2026
Crack the cases, Save the City. Here's your look at the Batman: Caped Crusader - Chronicles announcement trailer for this upcoming 1–4 player cooperative detective adventure game. Batman: Caped Crusader - Chronicles will be available on Amazon Luna on July 31, 2026.

Gotham's darkest crimes won't solve themselves. Go solo or gather your crew and dive into the noir-drenched 1940s Gotham City of the Batman: Caped Crusader animated series, where every alley hides a secret, and every case leads deeper into the shadowy depths of Gotham’s criminal minds.

In this cooperative party game for 1 to 4 players, you'll join forces with Renee Montoya as part of Batman’s inner circle, uncovering evidence, chasing leads, and confronting iconic villains across 11 gripping episodes. Test your detective skills to surface clues in 11 detective minigames. Investigate, interrogate, deduce and decode your way through the crime webs woven by 10 of Gotham’s most devious criminals, including Scarecrow, Babyface, Tweedledee and Tweedledum, Dollmaker, Lynx, Music Meister and of course, the Joker. 

Batman and the citizens of Gotham are counting on you!

Halo: Campaign Evolved - All 39 Skull Locations
In Halo: Campaign Evolved, there is a mix of new and old Skulls to find. There are 3 Skulls to find in each of the 13 missions (10 classic missions, 3 new bonus prologue missions) for a total of 39 Skulls. You also unlock 3 Skulls automatically after finding 3 total Skulls in any missions overall (which means there are 42 Skulls in this game). We will take you through the locations for all 39 Skulls, starting with the new prologue missions. We'll also start off by explaining how to better find Skulls with audio cues by tweaking your in-game audio settings. Timestamps for all of this are below.

Halo: Campaign Evolved - All Terminal Locations
In Halo: Campaign Evolved, there is one Terminal per chapter/mission, so there are 13 total to be found throughout the entire game. You do not need to play on any specific difficulty, and these Terminals will be available any time you start a new game or go back to a mission, so you can't miss any of them. We'll start with the three new prologue missions (bonus missions) and then go into the normal campaign missions. All timestamps are below.
